rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is textbook property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage to four shingles on the back porch overhang from last weekend. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible but is being routed for documentation and adjuster confirmation.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no water intrusion
